objective: Describe a future fail-closed boundary for exactly one bounded F&O database-quality audit attempt covering existing audit stages 1-3.
reuse: AuditApproval exact-payload hashing and fail-closed validation concepts
DurableAuditRegistry atomic registration, one-use consumption and hash-chained events
terminal attempt reconciliation and immutable evidence-store concepts
synthetic ReadOnlyCatalogConnection defense layers and bounded output contracts
pre-research PDF gate and exact owner-review binding
must_remain_separate: synthetic fixture locators and the private production locator
data-quality audit authority and market-research authority
audit evidence and promotable research evidence
proposal review, boundary implementation approval and one-use audit approval
identified_gaps: The current production boundary is deliberately impossible and has no usable production execution path.
The synthetic validator rejects the production locator and synthetic fixture classification cannot qualify a production database.
The R.9F identity does not bind or reconcile SQLite sidecars and is not a full-file hash.
A production-safe OS-level byte-read budget is not implemented.
The exact WAL/journal consistency policy requires owner review before implementation.
No current PDF or approval authorizes a boundary implementation or database connection.
security_principles: deny by default and terminally reject every mismatch
consume one-use authority durably before the first target connection
bind every mutable input to exact hashes or exact sanitized metadata
use enumerated statement templates rather than caller-supplied SQL
never expose the resolved private path in tracked evidence
do not promote audit artifacts into research evidence
crashes and failures never restore authority

alternative_source_policy.rule: If the local database fails qualification, evaluate lawful free alternatives, including official NSE F&O bhavcopies for lawfully accessible historical periods.
alternative_source_policy.trust_rule: Official status or availability alone does not establish completeness, point-in-time fidelity, retention permission or research fitness.
alternative_source_policy.access_rule: Do not bypass CAPTCHA, authentication, robots restrictions, rate limits, licences or access controls.
alternative_source_policy.qualification_rule: Apply the same provenance, point-in-time, identity, completeness, correction, retention and reproducibility gates.

non_goals: database repair, migration, export or mutation
